name: OpenRouter
summary: OpenRouter is a hosted API that puts hundreds of models from many providers behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint and one bill. It routes each request across providers and falls back to another provider when one returns an error. In August 2026 it announced it is joining Stripe.
facts: OpenRouter (New York); joining Stripe, announced Aug 2026
Provider list price, no markup on inference
First $25k/month free, then 5% of list price
goodFor: Trying many models with one key
watchOut: Platform fee on every credit top-up
Requests pass through a third party
Ownership change after the Stripe deal
